title: Enter gets a clearer front door
summary:
A community-heavy day: a smoother Enter dashboard, a considerably larger build-ideas garden, and some necessary repo plumbing.

enter.pollinations.ai received refreshed branding and design, a new FAQ section, and model aliases so people can reach supported models with less memorization and fewer tabs open.

Hacktoberfest contributors turned project ideas into issue-ready starting points, then expanded them with Discord bots, social bots, game integrations, Nano Banana inspiration, and 17 additional ideas across categories. The blank page has been asked to leave.

The monorepo now has a shared TypeScript registry and tsx runtime, environment files can stay synchronized with their encrypted counterparts, and PrisimIG joined the creative-projects showcase.
